title: India Hosts BRICS Summit, Modi Frames Gathering as Test of Strategic Autonomy
detail: India hosted the BRICS summit with Prime Minister Modi framing it as a demonstration of strategic autonomy as India navigates relationships with both Western and non-Western blocs amid US-Iran tensions and global tariff pressures. The summit underscores India's positioning as a bridge between competing geopolitical spheres ahead of the September 12-13 New Delhi Leaders' Summit.

media.caption: India hosts BRICS summit under Modi's strategic autonomy framing
